style_prefix: 2D game asset for a fantasy tower-defense web game. Hand-painted cartoon style, bold dark-brown outlines, soft cel shading with the light coming from the top-left, saturated slightly warm colors, chunky readable silhouette, slightly exaggerated proportions, 3/4 top-down camera (looking down about 35 degrees). One single object, centered, fully visible with a margin on every side, no text, no watermark, no frame, no ground shadow. Background: perfectly flat solid magenta #FF00FF with no gradient, no floor and no props. Never use magenta or hot pink inside the subject. Original design; do not imitate the characters of any existing game.

style_prefix_simple: 2D game asset for a casual fantasy tower-defense web game. Very simple flat-color vector illustration, like a mobile game icon: big bold shapes, thick dark-brown outlines, only 2 to 3 flat colors per material with at most one simple shadow tone, NO textures (no brick lines, no fur, no fabric folds, no scratches, no gradients, no glow effects, no particles), minimal details, a large readable silhouette that is still clear when shrunk to 60 pixels, cute slightly chunky proportions, 3/4 top-down camera. One single object, centered, fully visible with a margin on every side, nothing floating around it, no text, no watermark, no frame, no ground shadow. Background: perfectly flat solid magenta #FF00FF with no gradient, no floor and no props. Never use magenta or hot pink inside the subject. Original design; do not imitate the characters of any existing game.
